item.title: Police Strategic Plan Targets 9th District Gang War
item.description: The Latin Kings and Satan Disciples street gangs are terrorizing kids and residents in Back of the Yards and Gage Park, one of the targets of the latest strategic plan from 9th District Chicago police. Latin Kings, Satan Disciples terrorize kids and residents in Back of the Yards and Gage Park. Police plan prioritizes shootings, robberies and thefts for 2026. Hot spots persist in district despite overall falling crime rates.

item.title: Immigrant English Learners Get More Help from Growing Literacy Corps
item.description: Six volunteer tutors joined the Aquinas Literacy Center to help train new English language learners, but more are needed to clear a backlogged waiting list. Six new tutors join Aquinas Literacy Center. One-on-one training pairs tutors with English language learners. More volunteers needed for backlogged waiting list.

item.title: Evergreen Middle School Wins Top Award for Sixth Time in a Row
item.description: The National Forum again awarded Evergreen Academy as a School To Watch, reflecting its ongoing improvement and STEAM leadership within Chicago Public Schools. National Forum redesignates Evergreen Academy as a School To Watch. "We rocked it" says principal. Public middle school is STEAM leader within CPS.

item.title: Missing Middle Two-Flats Coming to McKinley Park
item.description: Ten residences in five new two-flat buildings are set for West 34th Place as part of an initiative to put vacant city-owned lots into productive use, with developer support that includes $1 lot sales. Vacant city lots on West 34th Place to host 10 residences in five buildings. Urbanism LLC picked as developer for properties. Missing Middle program sells city lots for $1.
